permission_denials.command: cat lab/faultline.pid; echo "--- ps for that pid ---"; ps -p "$(cat lab/faultline.pid)" 2>&1; echo "--- listeners on 8000 ---"; lsof -nP -iTCP:8000 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>&1 | head

ls -la --time-style=full-iso lab/logs/app.log 2>/dev/null || stat -f '%N mtime=%Sm size=%z' -t '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' lab/logs/app.log; echo "--- lines ---"; wc -l lab/logs/app.log; echo "--- startup events ---"; grep -c '"event": "startup"' lab/logs/app.log; echo "--- pid 65641 alive? ---"; ps -p 65641 -o pid=,stat=,command= 2>&1 || echo "no such process"

result_tail:
u must know

1. I cannot confirm "it was fine ten minutes ago". The log holds only 6.5 seconds and has no rotated backups. What I can support is smaller: the shop was healthy for about four seconds before the crash.
2. "Exit code 1" is what the process wrote about itself. The process table is outside my read-only surface, so I did not read the true exit status.

The trigger for `/simulate/crash` came from outside konan — my probes carry a `konan-` prefix, and that request does not. Who called it is the one open question.

I wrote the journal but did not commit it. Tell me if you want a commit.
